svg.text: Must deploy first — certs must exist in us-east-1
VPC | PUBLIC subnets (AZ1 + AZ2) | cidrMask: 24 | natGateways: 0 | NoNatGatewayAspect ✓
Application Load Balancer (Alb) — internet-facing | PUBLIC subnets
Authenticated: forwarded to Lambda target group
Registered as next action after Cognito auth
No VPC required — Lambda invoked directly by ALB
No VPC config — runs outside VPC
Invoked directly by ALB target group
Reads S3: lists reports, renders HTML dashboard
Triggered per request (serverless, no idle cost)
IAM: S3 GetObject + ListBucket on sla-reports-*
Allure HTML reports uploaded here by CI/CD
NoPublicAccessBlockAspect — overrides S3 blockPublicAccess to allow public reads | NoNatGatewayAspect — validates VPC has no NAT Gateways (cost guard)
STEP 2: cdk deploy ReportViewerInfraStack --context global=false | Profile: ds-shared | ap-southeast-2
